extra.comment: OAuth return URL. In a dev/standalone build it is `zedustore://auth/callback`; inside Expo Go it is the Metro dev URL, `exp://<host>:8081/--/auth/callback`, because Expo Go registers only the exp:// scheme. Whichever applies must be registered in Supabase -> Authentication -> URL Configuration -> Redirect URLs, or Google sign-in never comes back to the app. See apps/mobile/lib/redirect.ts.
